statement: Every automated Toolkit launch of a G0/G1/G2 worker, successor or permitted helper meets the shared pre-inference invariants in repo/scripts/toolkit-v3-launch-assurance.cjs, each through its own host adapter or launcher. ENFORCED means shipped code enforces the invariant on that path; evidence NATIVE means it was exercised on the real host, SOURCE_TEST means source tests only. Native qualification is a separate per-path field and is not raised by this record.

hosts: Claude Code 2.1.301 on Windows 11 (owner UAT host)

frozen_profile.statement: The supported profile is the four host routes above as they exist in this candidate. Paths outside it are listed with in_profile false and held.

manual_first_layer: A model or effort a human chooses for a manually launched first layer (dot, a directly opened lead or G2 chat) is advisory and outside this family.
